description: c3844 runtime smoke: force the weapon family through public .pdweapon FileProvider source, then load DY-357 by canonical catalog ID. This catches generated archives that populate the loader pool but are not bound as runtime catalog sources.

input_sequence.comment: catalog bootstrap extracts and walks base .pdweapon archives before the debug typed-load request fires.

exit after the forced weapon typed-load has either activated or emitted the source-only failure. This smoke intentionally stays out of the skip-intro stage dwell path so it only validates .pdweapon source binding and typed runtime activation.

required_lines: LOADER\.UNIVERSAL\.OK: kind=weapon scanned=\d+ registered=\d+ envelope_failures=0 register_failures=0
forbidden_patterns: typed 'base:dy357' Weapon has no public FileProvider source
CATALOG\.LIFECYCLE\.ACTIVATE: 'base:dy357' weapon runtime adapter rejected missing authored payload
